args.title: Fix password reset email pointing to localhost
args.body: Proposed change in src/notifications/templates.ts: update BASE_URL to utilize the application configuration module or properly configured environment settings rather than falling back to localhost:3000 in deployed environments.

result: Opened draft pull request 11 from repomind/issue-4201 for issue 4201.

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts
The password reset email uses process.env.PUBLIC_URL falling back to localhost:3000 instead of using the configured production public URL or config module settings, causing generated reset links to point to localhost in deployed environments.
